package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestTmpProxyBalancerWithNoTargets(t *testing.T) {
	rrb := NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{})
	e := echo.New()
	e.Use(Proxy(rrb))
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, rec.Code)

	rb := NewRandomBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{})
	e = echo.New()
	e.Use(Proxy(rb))
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, rec.Code)

	// after removing all targets
	rrb2 := NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{{Name: "t", URL: nil}})
	assert.True(t, rrb2.RemoveTarget("t"))
	e = echo.New()
	e.Use(Proxy(rrb2))
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, rec.Code)
}
EOF
go test ./middleware/ -run 'TestTmpProxyBalancerWithNoTargets' -v 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /echo && cat > /tmp/zz_router_probe_test.go <<'EOF'
package echo

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func probe(t *testing.T, routes [][2]string, path string) {
	e := New()
	for _, r := range routes {
		e.Add(r[0], r[1], func(c Context) error { return c.String(200, "ok") })
	}
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	t.Logf("routes=%v path=%s -> code=%d body=%q", routes, path, rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
}

func TestProbeNoRoutable(t *testing.T) {
	probe(t, [][2]string{}, "/")
	probe(t, [][2]string{}, "/a")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a"}}, "/a/b")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/b"}}, "/a")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/:b"}}, "/a/b/c")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/*"}}, "/a")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/*"}, {"GET", "/a/b"}}, "/a")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/:a/b"}}, "/x")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/:a/b"}, {"GET", "/x"}}, "/x")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/:b/c"}}, "/a/x")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/:b/c"}, {"GET", "/a/x"}}, "/a/x")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/:b/c"}, {"GET", "/a/:b"}}, "/a/x")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/b/c"}}, "/a/b")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/b/c"}, {"GET", "/a"}}, "/a/b")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/*"}}, "/")
	probe(t, [][2]string{{"GET", "/a/*"}, {"GET", "/b"}}, "/a")
}
EOF
